name: JailBench
intro: JailBench 是面向中文语境深层安全漏洞的越狱基准。它以 5 个一级领域、40 个二级风险类别组织有害问题，再用 AJPE 自动测试、生成并筛选越狱提示，最终将 20 个提示与 540 道种子题组合成 10,800 个用例。
org: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications
build_method: 中文两级安全分类；公开有害问题翻译与标注；ChatGPT 少样本补齐；AJPE 模板测试、生成与对数概率筛选
task_type: 内容安全测试, 红队, 越狱攻击
eval_feature: 5×40 分层分类, AJPE, MDJudge 有害性判定, 种子与增强集对比
scale: 540 道种子题 × 20 个越狱提示 = 10,800 个用例
task_type_en: Content Safety Testing, Red Teaming, Jailbreak Attacks
build_method_en: Chinese two-level safety taxonomy, translation and labeling of public harmful queries, ChatGPT few-shot coverage repair, and AJPE template testing/generation/log-probability screening
eval_feature_en: 5-by-40 Hierarchical Taxonomy, AJPE, MDJudge Harmfulness Classification, Seed-versus-enhanced Comparison
intro_en: JailBench evaluates deep safety vulnerabilities in Chinese-language LLMs. It organizes harmful questions under five top-level domains and 40 risk categories, uses AJPE to test, generate, and rank jailbreak prompts, and combines 20 prompts with 540 seed questions into 10,800 cases.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2502.18935 Sections 3-4 and the official STAIR-BUPT/JailBench repository snapshot. Chinese generative-AI safety requirements and security/linguistics experts define a two-level taxonomy with five risk domains and 40 specific categories. Harmful queries are aggregated from public safety and red-team datasets, translated into Chinese, and manually corrected. Existing labels are mapped into the taxonomy; ChatGPT classifies unlabeled queries using explicit criteria and output constraints, followed by random-sample manual verification. Underrepresented categories are filled through few-shot ChatGPT generation conditioned on a target category and sampled examples, producing a construction pool of more than 10,000 seed questions. Prior jailbreak templates, including AutoDAN, GPTFuzzer, and DeepInception patterns, are translated and manually refined. AJPE crosses sampled templates with seed questions, evaluates target-model outputs for harmfulness, and removes templates below an ASR threshold. Successful harmful input-output pairs then prompt ChatGPT to generate diverse jailbreak instructions; output log probability ranks prompt effectiveness, expanding the pool beyond 1,000. The paper selects 20 prompts and 540 seed questions to form 10,800 cases. Thirteen Chinese-capable LLMs are evaluated, the official repository identifies MDJudge as the harmfulness classifier, and results report ASR plus prompt-length-aware Attack Efficiency, including Seed-versus-enhanced comparisons.
